disclaimer: Guideline references support clinician-facing prompts only. Confirm the full guideline, local protocol, patient-specific factors, professional scope and current revisions before applying.

guidelines.title: Wound infection in clinical practice: Principles of best practice, Fourth Edition
guidelines.publisher: International Wound Infection Institute / Wounds International
guidelines.scope: Wound infection assessment, prevention and management.

guidelines.title: IWGDF/IDSA Guidelines on the Diagnosis and Treatment of Diabetes-Related Foot Infections
guidelines.scope: Clinical diagnosis and severity classification of diabetes-related foot infection; microbiology and referral.
guidelines.notes: Current published edition used in this build; IWGDF states the practical guidance will be updated in 2027.

guidelines.title: Guidelines on offloading foot ulcers in persons with diabetes
guidelines.scope: Offloading selection, including neuropathic plantar forefoot/midfoot ulcers.
guidelines.notes: Current published edition used in this build; review when the next IWGDF update is released.

guidelines.title: Prevention and Treatment of Pressure Ulcers/Injuries: Clinical Practice Guideline, Fourth Edition
guidelines.scope: Pressure injury risk, skin/tissue assessment, classification, nutrition, repositioning, support surfaces and wound healing.

guidelines.title: Leg ulcer infection: antimicrobial prescribing
guidelines.scope: Antimicrobial stewardship and reassessment for clinically infected leg ulcers; not a general venous-ulcer compression guideline.
